name: ATTACH_FILE_BASIC
description: ATTACH DATABASE '<file>' AS alias creates+uses external db

name: ATTACH_MEMORY_AS_AUX
description: ATTACH ':memory:' AS aux gives an isolated in-memory schema

name: DETACH_AFTER_ATTACH
description: DETACH alias removes the attachment; database_list reflects it

name: QUALIFIED_TABLE_REF
description: Qualified table reference alias.tbl reads from attached schema

name: SCHEMA_ISOLATION_SAME_NAME
description: Same-named table in main vs aux: each schema owns its own rows

name: MAIN_VS_AUX_SQLITE_MASTER
description: main.sqlite_master vs aux.sqlite_master expose per-db schemas

name: CROSS_DB_JOIN
description: JOIN across main and aux schemas works as a single query

name: CROSS_DB_INSERT_SELECT
description: INSERT INTO aux.dst SELECT FROM main.src moves rows across databases

name: TXN_SPANS_ATTACHED_DBS
description: Single transaction covering writes to main and aux (temp_store=MEMORY)

name: DOT_DATABASES_LISTS_ATTACHED
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
ATTACH DATABASE ':memory:' AS aux;
.databases

name: PRAGMA_DATABASE_LIST_ATTACHED
description: PRAGMA database_list enumerates main + attached schemas

name: DETACH_NONEXISTENT_ERROR
description: DETACH of an unknown alias raises 'no such database'

name: ATTACH_SAME_ALIAS_TWICE_ERROR
description: ATTACHing the same alias twice fails with 'already in use'
expected_stderr_contains: database aux is already in use

name: SCHEMA_VERSION_PER_DB
description: schema_version is independent per attached database

name: PRAGMA_MAIN_USER_VERSION_SET
description: PRAGMA main.user_version=42 sets and reads back on main schema

name: PRAGMA_AUX_USER_VERSION_ISOLATED
description: PRAGMA aux.user_version is isolated from main.user_version

name: ALIAS_QUALIFIED_UPDATE_DELETE
description: Qualified UPDATE / DELETE target only the alias.tbl rows

name: DETACH_THEN_QUALIFIED_REF_ERROR
description: After DETACH, qualified reference to old alias errors as 'no such table'
